description: Which files of a development commit enter the public source release. Applied by tools/export-public-source.py; every exclusion carries its reason.

exclude.docs/fork/**: Historical development reports, screenshots and private notes; curated files listed under keep are published
exclude..github/workflows/**: Upstream deployment configuration omitted; no release deployment authorized
exclude.wrangler.jsonc: Upstream deployment configuration omitted; no release deployment authorized
exclude.Characters_F2.9_update/**: Unapproved character review drafts awaiting author sign-off
exclude.characters/models/*/character.REVIEW.yam: Unapproved character review draft awaiting author sign-off
exclude.characters/models/*/SYSTEM.CANDIDATE.txt: Unapproved character review draft awaiting author sign-off
exclude.app/**: Upstream local headset/VLC app alpha (Node host); not part of this Linux bundle
exclude.packaging/**: Upstream Flatpak/portable packaging; this fork ships its own installer
exclude.manifest-dev.json: Upstream dev-site install manifest; this build uses the live manifest
exclude.icon-dev*: Upstream dev-site artwork; this build uses the live icon
exclude.src/js/session-telemetry.test.js: Upstream redaction test embeds a synthetic device MAC; the release privacy scan admits no MAC-shaped strings

art.reason: Only portraits referenced by the character catalog are authorized for publication
